description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of records related to cost data, grouping and structuring it for visualization in charts. It supports categorization by environment or cost category, fills missing categories with a specified label, and sorts agents and categories optionally.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost aggregate records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, grouping by agent name and a secondary dimension (environment or cost category); ensures consistent categories across agents with zero-fill where data is missing.
